create.name: Fondazione Maitreya
create.bio:
Fondazione Maitreya is an Italian Buddhist cultural institute founded in Rome in 1984 by Vincenzo Piga and his wife Giuseppina Petti. Piga, a former trade unionist and journalist, was one of the pioneers of Buddhism in Italy and in 1985 helped create the Italian Buddhist Union. The foundation belongs to no single school: it presents teachings from several traditions, encourages interfaith dialogue and works with cultural institutions. Today it is chaired by Maria Angela Falà, and its sanghas meet in Rome, Milan and Livorno, with teachings offered freely on a dana basis and teachers and staff unpaid.

In Milan the sangha runs two-day Vipassana mini-courses for beginners and longer residential retreats in the line of Sayagyi U Ba Khin, alongside Satipatthana and Anapanasati retreats. From Rome, Lama Neljorpa Lodreu (Jean Paul Niel), a student of Kalu Rinpoche and Bokar Rinpoche, leads silent Mahamudra retreats at Casa Maitreya, the foundation's retreat house opened in 2024 among olive groves near Mompeo in the Sabina hills, with room for fifteen people. The foundation also organises the Incontri Cinema Buddhista film festival, published the journal Dharma from 1999 to 2012, and its YouTube channel holds talks and question sessions by visiting Theravada monks, lamas and Italian teachers.

courses.title: Mini Corsi di Meditazione Vipassana
courses.description: A two-day weekend Vipassana course in Milan for beginners and practitioners, with standing, walking and sitting meditation, teachings and sharing. Teaching is free; an advance free offering confirms the place, and bursaries are available. Next dates 30–31 January 2027, with booking opening in December.

courses.title: Ritiro dell'Immacolata 2026 di Meditazione Vipassana
courses.description: A residential Vipassana retreat in the tradition of Sayagyi U Ba Khin and Mother Sayama at the Pian dei Ciliegi meditation centre near Ponte dell'Olio (Piacenza), open to beginners and experienced meditators, with five precepts, breath awareness and insight practice.

courses.title: Ritiri Residenziali a Casa Maitreya – Trasmissione Mahāmudra Dzong Chen
courses.description: Silent residential retreats at Casa Maitreya near Mompeo (Rieti) led by Lama Neljorpa Lodreu, with sitting and walking contemplation and physical and breathing yoga in the Kagyu Mahamudra tradition. Teaching is free; a contribution to the house covers board and lodging. The foundation's calendar lists the next one for 2–6 January 2027.
